ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI logistics agent that negotiates delivery schedules and updates shipment routes over automated phone calls using voice synthesis, managed via crypto escrow.
ideas.title: VoiceAgent Dispatch
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the ElevenLabs sponsor track while hitting the primary hackathon theme of autonomous agents and integrating a proven marketplace payment pattern.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered voice triage agent for rural clinics that conducts initial patient intake conversations via phone calls, synthesizes medical summaries, and populates health dashboards.
ideas.title: AuraCare Voice Triage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines ElevenLabs voice technology with high-impact healthcare automation, heavily appealing to judges looking for real-world utility and sponsor tech integration.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous Web3 compliance and risk-monitoring agent that investigates suspicious multi-chain transaction flows and generates plain-English audio threat briefs.
ideas.title: Aegis Ledger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Bridges blockchain risk analysis with ElevenLabs audio briefings, aligning with the blockchain focus and winning sponsor track criteria.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous agricultural planning agent that monitors regional satellite land metrics and uses voice synthesis to deliver spoken daily irrigation and resource optimization guides to farmers.
ideas.title: EcoVoice Planner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages satellite compliance monitoring patterns while utilizing ElevenLabs for accessibility, making it stand out in both technical depth and sponsor alignment.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous video intelligence agent that watches recorded lectures or meetings, extracts key action items, and generates conversational podcasts or interactive audio briefings.
ideas.title: OmniVoice Video Intelligence
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the ElevenLabs sponsor track by turning unstructured data pipelines into immersive voice experiences.
